source_text: Similarly, Indonesia's Majelis Ulama Indonesia (MUI) issued Fatwa No. 28/DSN-MUI/III/2003 and reaffirmed in subsequent statements that mild khitan perempuan (female circumcision), such as a superficial cut without removal, is makrumah and not forbidden, provided it adheres to health guidelines and avoids excess. [45]
